name: Triangulum
introduction: is the Triangle, a small group of three stars between Andromeda and Aries. It is one of Ptolemy’s original 48 constellations.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Triangulum contains the Triangulum Galaxy, M33, about 3 million light-years away. It is the third-largest galaxy in our Local Group, after Andromeda and the Milky Way, and on very dark nights some observers can see it with the naked eye.
Within M33 lies NGC 604, one of the largest known regions of star formation, glowing with gas lit by hundreds of hot young stars.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alaybasan](hip:10064), Beta Trianguli, is the brightest star, a white giant. [Mothallah](hip:8796), Alpha Trianguli, is a yellow-white star 64 light-years away, and [Apdu](hip:10670) a white star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Unlike the Milky Way and Andromeda, M33 shows no supermassive black hole at its center, only a dense cluster of stars, a clue to how differently galaxies can grow.
